description: Version-controlled release verification matrix (issue #28 Phase B). One entry per declared native target x verification stage. `required` entries must be attested by the named lane at the exact release-candidate SHA before scripts/release_gate_check.py may certify a release candidate. `status` records the CURRENT executed state of this repository's CI: PASS only when a cited executed lane covers it; BLOCKED/NOT_RUN are never green. Optional PASS entries are reported but never substitute for a required gap.

evidence_classes.official_binary_clean_room: Real official ACP binary executed in a dedicated-OS-UID GitHub-hosted clean room.
evidence_classes.official_binary_hosted: Real official ACP binary executed on a native GitHub-hosted runner (no dedicated-UID isolation).
evidence_classes.real_core_integration: Executed against an unmodified official Hermes Core checkout (strict seam or provider probe).
evidence_classes.fake_transport_protocol: Deterministic credential-free fake-ACP protocol contract; OS-independent; never claims real-binary or vendor-auth behavior.
evidence_classes.registry_pin_only: Publisher digest pinned in antigravity_acp/registry.py with no executed native lifecycle.
evidence_classes.not_executed: No executed evidence exists in this repository's CI for this cell.

stages.binary_publisher_pin_sha256: Official distribution downloaded under the reviewed first-party SHA-256 pin and digest-verified before execution.
stages.install_status_verify_uninstall: Install -> status -> integrity verify -> uninstall -> confirmed absence lifecycle.
stages.provider_registration_enabled: Hermes provider projection registered under HERMES_HOME and observed enabled (hermes plugins list or provider probe).
stages.provider_selection_factory: providers.get_provider_profile discovery, profile field equality, and create_client factory path executed under an official Hermes Core venv.
stages.acp_initialize_unauthenticated: Unauthenticated ACP initialize handshake against the real official binary (no auth frame, no prompt).
stages.error_timeout_permission_failclosed: Error, timeout and permission-denial paths fail closed (fake-transport protocol class; real-binary diagnostics are covered under platform_security_hardening).
stages.session_resume_recovery: Session resume/recovery protocol contract (fake-transport protocol class).
stages.platform_security_hardening: Platform-specific additional security verification (dedicated-UID isolation and fail-closed diagnostics on Linux x86_64; owned process-tree teardown on Windows x64).
